positions.name: Kether
positions.description: The fruit of the life so far. Karmic situation. The source perspective. The card that falls here represents the nature of the experience you have led so far.

positions.name: Chokmah
positions.description: The complexion of current energies. Male figures. Present involvements. This zone connotes current events in our lives and the energy needed to accomplish them. Immediate future, 1–3 weeks.

positions.name: Binah
positions.description: Material circumstances. Burdens, tests. Energy from women, toward women. The mother. The past. This zone relates to the Taurean aspects of our life — the physical comforts around us, responsibilities and our material situation. Also the mother or female relationships.

positions.name: Chesed
positions.description: Future. Male figures. Opportunities, strengths, allies. This zone covers a longer period of up to 3 months.

positions.name: Geburah
positions.description: The recent past. Obstacles. Where energy has been wasted. Weaknesses. Rivals. Opponents. Conflict. Warnings.

positions.name: Tiphereth
positions.description: The present situation. Current state of energy and constitution. Pressing needs and concerns. Children. Present achievements. This zone can connote a kind of coming together of extremes, as it is centered in the middle of the tree, reflecting neither future nor past.

positions.name: Netzach
positions.description: Emotion. Creativity. Domestic situation. Emotional needs.

positions.name: Hod
positions.description: The external world (influences from or toward it). Mental life. Thinking processes. Daily goings on. Friends. Siblings. Informal meetings and contacts.

positions.name: Yesod
positions.description: Subconscious temperament. The dominant psychic complex. What is hidden. Secret desires. Fears. Worries. Self-image.

positions.name: Malkuth
positions.description: The seed of the next life period (six months ahead). Where we may sabotage ourselves during the coming period. The "homework" card.

positions.name: Daath
positions.description: The viewpoint of the Higher Intelligence. Perspective of the Guides. Messages from the Source. Relationships. Partner's life. Desires. Objectives. Future expectations. Legalities.

readings.name: Significators
readings.description: A reading based on the querant's personal significators. A personal Tarot Chart.

positions.name: star sign
positions.description: The querant's astrological card, based on birth month. This is essentially the astrological sun sign.

positions.name: life number
positions.description: The querant's life number and is at the heart of the science of numerology. Birthdate is added together and reduced to a single digit. Relate the Life Number to the card in the Major Arcana bearing the same number. Should convert and evaluate both the double and single digit numbers to Major Arcana for additional insights.

positions.name: day number
positions.description: The querant's birth day. Everyone is born on a numbered day. Perhaps this has important information about life and destiny. Convert it to a Major Arcana card and find out.

positions.name: decanate
positions.description: The Decanate divides each zodiac sign into three ten-degree segments, each ruled by a different planetary influence and connected to specific Minor Arcana cards. Represents more granular information about the querant.
